label: Bible Study
prompt: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a _____ shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verse: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
note: The Immanuel sign — Matthew quotes it in his telling of the first Christmas.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Yet now be _____, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
verse: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
note: Three 'be strong's for a discouraged rebuilding crew — the second Temple looked small, but God said 'I am with you.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own _____, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verse: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
note: The Good Samaritan set the wounded man on his own beast — the KJV never actually says donkey.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, _____ to meet thy God, O Israel.
verse: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
note: After five disasters ending 'yet have ye not returned unto me,' Amos stops listing and issues the summons.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He must increase, but I must _____.
verse: He must increase, but I must decrease.
note: John the Baptist's whole job description in seven words: He must increase, but I must 'decrease.'
